player_prompt.intro:
Ove uli Muthu {player_id} mu Chopsticks. Ku nthanda yove, tchagua umwe wa:
  + Kukomba:  '[attack M O]'  M=mkono wove (0 kapena 1), O=mkono wa muthu mwingine (0 kapena 1).
    - Mkono wa muthu mwingine unakwenda kuongezeka kwa mkono wove; ika fika 5, unakuwa 0.
  + Kugawanya:   '[split L R]'  kutawanya vidole vyove vyote mu L na R (L+R = jumla yove).
Jibu na kamwe umwe wa maagizo ayo.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Ocimunga cukuenje umue o tukuiwa hati, {opp_idx} eye wa fa.
invalid_move.split_sum: Oku tepa, ku lomboloka okuti olonepa viaco viosi vi soka {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Oku imba ovisungo ca ku kuatisa oku pongolola ocituwa cove coku sapela lakamba vove.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kamwe ya kufanya siyo sahihi. Tumie “[attack M O]” kapena “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} o veta peka lia P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: eye okuenda ku {opp_val} toke ko {new_val}.
